profile.punto2: Design of your 30, 60, and 90-second Professional Pitch.

fases.titulo: How We Help You Thrive in 12 Weeks
fases.subtitulo: The program is structured into three progressive 4-session phases, taking you from professional identity to high-stakes execution.

fase1.preguntaEje: “Why should a global company hire me?”
fase1.descripcion: We craft your professional identity, career audit, 60-second Pitch, and strategic company research before answering a single question.

fase2.preguntaEje: “How do I prove my value with evidence?”
fase2.descripcion: We build your STAR + L stories, train timed behavioral interviews, reframe difficult questions, and record your first virtual simulation.

fase3.preguntaEje: “Can I perform under real interview pressure?”
fase3.descripcion: You master salary negotiation, build your 30-60-90 Day Plan, and complete 2 full Mock Interviews with a Final Scorecard and action plan.

syllabus.subtitulo: Every 60 to 90-minute session concludes with a tangible deliverable built for your real target application.

s1.objetivo: Understand modern global selection processes and define your professional value proposition.

s2.objetivo: Build a compelling 30, 60, and 90-second pitch connecting your background with the target role.

s3.objetivo: Conduct deep intelligence on a real target company (mission, products, culture, news) and align your value.

s4.objetivo: Prove your strengths with impact evidence and present development areas with genuine self-awareness.

s5.objetivo: Turn your professional background into high-impact stories structured with the STAR + L method.

s6.objetivo: Retrieve relevant stories in under 30 seconds for leadership, teamwork, and high-pressure behavioral prompts.

s7.objetivo: Transform uncomfortable questions (career transitions, CV gaps) into confident professional narratives.

s8.objetivo: Master camera presence, vocal tone, conciseness, and communication across multicultural teams.

s9.objetivo: Discuss salary expectations, benefits, and total compensation in English with executive confidence.

s10.objetivo: Design a strategic first 30, 60, and 90-day onboarding plan that sets you apart for mid-level and senior roles.

s11.objetivo: Complete your first full 30–40 minute practical simulation covering all 8 core interview blocks.

s12.objetivo: Perform in an uninterrupted 45-minute real position global interview and receive your Readiness Report™.

faq.titulo: Clear Answers Before Starting Your Journey
faq.subtitulo: Everything you need to know about our selective admission process, English requirements, and weekly dynamics.
faq.q1Pregunta: What English level do I need to join the program?
faq.q1Respuesta: Before joining, every candidate completes a 20–30 minute Global Career Diagnostic. If you have an upper-intermediate or advanced foundation, you enter the 12-week program directly. If you need language reinforcement first, we guide you to our Leveling / Professional English Track.
faq.q2Pregunta: How does working with a real job opening from Week 1 work?
faq.q2Respuesta: In Week 1 you select a real target role and three companies of interest. Across all 12 sessions, your pitch, company intelligence, STAR+L stories, and 30-60-90 Day Plan are built specifically to win that target opportunity.
faq.q3Pregunta: How is this different from preparing interview answers on my own?
faq.q3Respuesta: International recruiters immediately spot memorized scripts. At Top-Notch you build a rapid evidence retrieval system (STAR Challenge, Difficult Question Roulette) and receive expert coaching on body language, tone, structure, and camera presence.
faq.q4Pregunta: What tangible deliverables do I walk away with after 3 months?
faq.q4Respuesta: You finish with 12 concrete assets: your 60–90s Pitch, STAR+L story bank, difficult question scripts, salary strategy, a 30-60-90 Day Plan, at least 2 full Mock Interviews, your Global Interview Readiness Report™, and official certification.
